If players have lost their teleport seed, they can obtain a new one by killing elf warriors in Lletya. This is the fastest method, and killing elves in any other location does not work.
It is not possible to obtain a teleport seed by talking to Ilfeen, Eluned, Islwyn or Rhodri Dail. They can only be used to recharge an existing teleport seed.

The crystal teleport seed has 3 right-click destinations that can be unlocked after the appropriate quests have been completed (see below). The Prifddinas option opens a dialogue box that allows the player to teleport to any of the city's eight elven clan districts.
To unlock the Temple of Light option, players must speak to Eluned in Isafdar or Prifdinnas (not via the NPC contact spell). This will only work when carrying one seed; carrying multiple seeds will prevent the teleport from being added.
Alternatively, if the player has completed The Light Within, Eluned is replaced with Islwyn. Players need to speak to Islwyn at the Ithell Clan district in Prifddinas near the singing bowl instead. Here, he will speak to the player about chanting the crystal with new teleports.
To unlock the Prifddinas option, players must walk onto the bridge to Prifddinas for the first time to trigger a skippable cutscene, after which the option is unlocked automatically.

The amount of coins needed to create (and repair) is based on the number of times a crystal weapon/armour seed has been made into an item for coins - the cost is shared over all crystal weapons and shields. tx:
Any amount of training experience in any skill, even 1 experience, was all that was necessary for that skill (combat or non-combat) to count as completing one of the skills needed to obtain the reward. Experience rewards such as quests and minigames did not count towards the experience requirement.
To claim the reward, players had to wait three hours for the aura to deplete, or manually deactivate it after gaining experience in the 10 skills required. Right-clicking on the aura while equipped and selecting "Aura time remaining" would help players determine if all of experience requirements had been met. A message would appear in the chat box after earning experience in the last necessary skill. 
Until the reward book was claimed, any experience gained in addition to that needed to earn the reward did not count towards a further reward.
After fulfilling the requirements and practicing all skills needed, players could talk to Xuan, Dilwyn, or Wafa to receive a reward book. 
Attempting to activate the aura while in possession of a reward book would result in the message: 
The experience reward was:
\frac{m}{2}\left(x^2-2x+100\right),
where x is the level of the skill on which the reward book is used and m is a multiplier based on the type of reward book:
• Normal: 3
• Master: 4
• Supreme: 5
• Legendary: 6
